textos.titulo: Linu Sites — custom websites and web apps
textos.descricao: Business websites, tools with dashboards and web apps that install on your phone. We design, build, launch and look after the server.
textos.og_descricao: Custom websites and web apps, from design to server.
textos.og_imagem_alt: Linu Sites: custom websites and web apps, with Linu at the research station
textos.h1: A website that works for your business.
textos.abertura_sub: From a business website to a tool with a dashboard and logins: we design, build, launch and look after the server. You talk directly to the people who make it.
textos.cena_alt: Pixel art illustration of a research station in Antarctica, with a desk, a computer and maps on the wall
textos.cena_legenda: Linu's station, where the websites are made.
textos.servicos_sub: Every project is built from scratch, around the way your business works.
textos.apresentacao_texto: To say who you are, what you offer and how to reach you. Fast, great on mobile and easy to find on Google.
textos.ferramenta_texto: Order forms, calculators, customer logins and a dashboard to keep track of it all. Your website stops being a shop window and becomes part of the work.
textos.app_texto: Web apps that sit on the phone's home screen like any other app and even open offline, with no app store in between.
textos.hospedagem_texto: Domain, security padlock (HTTPS), server and backups. You don't need to understand any of it.
textos.plano_no_ar_aria: Online plan, {{p.plano_no_ar}} a month: build a quote
textos.plano_cuidado_aria: Care plan, {{p.plano_cuidado}} a month: build a quote
textos.planos_nota: Care includes updates and small text and photo changes. Pay for the year and get 2 months free.
textos.precos_nota: Reference prices to start the conversation. The final quote, in writing, depends on what goes into the project. Domain registration (about {{p.dominio_ano}} a year) is paid separately.
textos.no_ar_sub: Real websites, in use right now. Go ahead and try them.
textos.linupedia_alt: LinuPedia's main screen: the linuhub list, with the campfire, Linu's tent and the study areas of the main tent
textos.linupedia_texto: Language app and playable encyclopedia, with 197 languages and 39 areas of knowledge. Works offline on phones and computers.
textos.v2tech_alt: V²Tech COMBUSTÍVEL home page showing the fair price of diesel
textos.v2tech_texto: Checks whether the diesel, petrol or ethanol price a supplier charges makes sense, cross-checking data from Petrobras, Brazil's fuel regulator and its tax authority.
textos.losvega_alt: Los Vega na Estrada home page, tailor-made travel itineraries
textos.losvega_texto: Tailor-made travel itineraries: the customer describes the trip and sees the price straight away; requests land in a dashboard with a ready-made WhatsApp reply.
textos.marginalia_alt: Marginalia home page, a History and humanities publication
textos.marginalia_texto: Independent History and humanities magazine, with contents, search, notes in the margin and ready-to-copy citations.
textos.iconvet_alt: Iconvet home page, a veterinary clinic in Salvador, featuring its imaging department
textos.iconvet_texto: Veterinary clinic in Salvador, Brazil: departments, tests, services and specialities across 74 pages, with WhatsApp and directions one tap away.
textos.ajoriente_alt: Administração Judicial Oriente home page: “Guiding companies to new beginnings”
textos.ajoriente_texto: Insolvency administration in Rio de Janeiro: practice areas, case lookup by company, document templates and contact.
textos.dojo_alt: Dojo Legacy home page: “From white belt to mat legend”, with the game on a computer and a phone
textos.dojo_texto: Jiu-Jitsu and MMA career game, free in the browser, on iPhone and on Android, with PvP, team leagues and live rankings.
textos.omega_alt: Ômega Imóveis home page: “The right place changes everything”, over Rio's South Zone at sunset
textos.omega_texto: Estate agency in Rio's South Zone, on a one-page website that presents how they work and the neighbourhoods they cover.
textos.minhocao_alt: The Minhocão start screen: the title over the dark ICC corridor, the name field for the roll call and the button to enter
textos.minhocao_texto: First-person horror game set in the Minhocão, the ICC of the University of Brasília, free in the browser on computer and phone. It blends fiction with the university’s real history under the dictatorship. Ages 14 and up.
textos.trupe_alt: The Trupe project board: notes held up with tape, each showing the disciplines sought and the kind of participation
textos.trupe_texto: A network where artists from every discipline find each other and make projects together: a project board, communities and real-time conversations. In preview.
textos.estudo_sub: Projects I made at university. The companies are fictional; the code is open source.
textos.cafe_alt: Café Aurora home page: the name in blue and pink neon over a cyberpunk city at night
textos.cafe_texto: A cyberpunk café that doesn't exist, with an intro screen, animated background, menu and a lab to build your drink. It's the website in the simulator above, also in Bootstrap and Tailwind versions.
textos.cerrado_alt: Fotografia do Cerrado home page: a seriema in golden grass, with a flowering pink ipê tree behind
textos.cerrado_texto: Wildlife photography company, with a filterable gallery, expeditions and contact. The palette comes from the Cerrado itself and every colour was checked against the WCAG contrast rules.
textos.abelhas_alt: Abelhas sem Ferrão home page: the question about the 250 species next to photos of the jataí, uruçu and mandaçaia bees
textos.abelhas_texto: For people who have never heard of Brazil's native stingless bees: a 3-minute tour, what to do if you find a nest and a quick quiz. It grew out of a Design Thinking exercise.
textos.exemplo_titulo: Switch it on and off, see the price
textos.exemplo_sub: Café Aurora is a café that doesn't exist, from another dimension. Switch parts of its website on and off: it changes instantly, and so does the price.
textos.simulador_efeitos: Effects: animated background, neon and cursor
textos.simulador_nota: Reference prices, as in “Build your website”. The monthly plan (from {{p.plano_no_ar}}) is separate.
textos.simulador_botao: I want a website like this
textos.simulador_iframe: Café Aurora, example website for a fictional café
textos.simulador_credito: Café Aurora started as a university assignment, in the Interface Development module.
textos.depoimentos_titulo: Clients with a website by us
textos.passo1_texto: You tell us what you need, who the website is for and what it should solve.
textos.passo2_texto: We come back with what's included, the timeline and the price, in writing.
textos.passo3_texto: You follow a live preview from day one and ask for changes along the way.
textos.passo4_texto: The website goes onto your domain, securely, and keeps being looked after.
textos.europa_acess_texto: The European Accessibility Act has applied since June 2025, and WCAG 2.2 is the current version of the web accessibility guidelines. What this page already does: AA-level contrast in light and dark modes, visible focus, everything reachable by keyboard and, with “reduce motion” on, the animations stop. The Café Aurora in the simulator is left out: it's a separate example site. This isn't a certification or a guarantee of legal compliance.
textos.europa_priv_texto: This website has no cookies, trackers, CDN or Google Fonts: everything comes from our own server. The theme and language you choose are stored only in your browser.
textos.duvidas_sub: What everyone asks before starting. Whatever applies to your project comes in writing in the proposal.
textos.faq_prazo_r: A rough guide: a business website takes 2 to 3 weeks, a tool with a dashboard 1 to 2 months and an installable app 2 to 3 months. The exact timeline, agreed for your project, comes in the proposal.
textos.faq_pagamento_r: Half when you accept the proposal and half before the website goes onto your domain. For projects from {{p.ferramenta}}, you can split it into three: 40% at the start, 30% when the preview is approved and 30% at launch. You get an invoice in euros and pay by SEPA transfer through Wise. Between businesses, where it applies, VAT is under the reverse charge: the buyer accounts for it in their own country.
textos.faq_mensal_p: Do I have to pay every month?
textos.faq_mensal_r: Yes: the website runs on our server, and the monthly plan keeps it online. There are two plans. Online ({{p.plano_no_ar}} a month) covers the server, security padlock, domain setup and backups. Care ({{p.plano_cuidado}} a month) has all that plus updates and small text and photo changes. Pay for the year up front and get 2 months free.
textos.faq_painel_p: Can I edit the website myself?
textos.faq_painel_r: Yes. With the dashboard you change text and photos without calling anyone, and you get a quick training session and a guide. Tools and apps include it; on a business website it's an extra {{p.painel}}. New pages are still done by us.
textos.faq_dominio_r: You do. By default it's registered in your or your company's name, with your country's domain (.co.uk, .ie, .eu or .com), and we set everything up. If you'd rather not deal with it, we handle registration and renewals for you.
textos.faq_dados_p: What about the text, photos and data?
textos.faq_dados_r: They're yours: whatever you send us, the text and images we create for the website (once paid) and the data of the people who use it, such as orders and sign-ups. The code, layout and design belong to Linu Sites; you use the website while the monthly plan is active.
textos.faq_sair_p: What if I want to leave one day?
textos.faq_sair_r: You get your text, images and data in a file, ready to take with you. If you want to take the website as it is, its code can be bought for the same price as the project. Nobody is locked in.
textos.contato_texto: Build your website and instantly see an estimated price and timeline. Then send it by WhatsApp or email: the message is already written. It can be just an idea: the reply comes with questions and next steps.
